scroll_track.input: trusted pointerdown alternates 80%/20% of the vertical track; native scrollTop and projected thumb reach a frame before pointerup

open_ready.endpoint: same accepted role node connected, with a nonempty rect, no hidden/inert ancestor and visible computed visibility on an animation frame; not paint presentation or autofocus completion
open_ready.input_pacing: current Dialog/Tooltip open samples wait for ready before the next input; baseline releases after logical DOM acceptance. Matched latency_ms/dom_frame_ms retain that first logical DOM endpoint.
open_ready.source: opening rows from the existing matched workload, excluding its five warmups; no additional rounds or baseline delta
